<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election integrity disputes:</strong> Opposition parties are intensifying their protests against the Election Commission and the proposed SIR through &quot;mock Parliaments,&quot; while RTI disclosures reveal the Cabinet Secretary dismissed earlier complaints from Election Commissioners as unofficial.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxPUXhMNW05RVRPNnBDUDhWVFZtZDU4cVlwc3FFenB4Nm4wWVFJM1ZHRjNXb05PMHdXNVVBUUdFbDVnRHpJQ1N3ZDhaZXJNbHF0Q19ORG9hUFNOZGs5c1QyWnBraTRpZ0V6VGZwaHZYbGpXQm1KLVdRRlVhUlh5OGZZSFBXbEJzU2ktTWJEc1U5bUttcWdiNHZHVnpiM2ZkSDlrdi1qVg?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Inter-state territorial conflict:</strong> The Odisha government has approached the Supreme Court to challenge the conduct of Andhra Pradesh elections within the disputed Kotia region.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>

</ul>
